disclosures.text: Switching device for high-pressure tools
at least two high-pressure tools are switchable between rest and working states
the device comprises a first part with a high-pressure medium supply channel
the device comprises a second part with at least two high-pressure medium discharge channels
the first and second parts are relatively movable
a first position connects a first discharge channel to the supply channel
in the first position, a second discharge channel is separated from the supply channel
a second position separates the first discharge channel from the supply channel
in the second position, the second discharge channel connects to the supply channel
High-pressure system for cleaning or machining workpieces
the system comprises at least one switching device
Method for switching at least two high-pressure tools
tools switchable from rest to working state and vice versa
supplying high-pressure medium to a first tool via a switching device
the switching device has a first part with a supply channel
the switching device has a second part with at least two discharge channels
in a first position, a first discharge channel connects to the supply channel and the first tool
in the first position, a second discharge channel connects to a second tool but is separate from the supply channel
transferring the device from the first position to a second position
in the second position, the first discharge channel is separated from the supply channel

A switching device for high-pressure tools, having a first part with a supply channel and a second part with at least two discharge channels, where the parts are movable to connect one discharge channel at a time to the supply channel.
A high-pressure system for cleaning or machining workpieces, comprising at least one switching device as described in claim 1.

A method for switching high-pressure tools, comprising supplying medium to a first tool via a switching device in a first position, and then transferring the device to a second position to supply medium to a second tool.
the second part includes at least one bypass channel
the bypass channel is temporarily in fluid communication with the supply channel during switching
the bypass channel is separated from the supply channel in the first or second position
at least one bypass channel opens into a bypass collecting channel
the bypass collecting channel is on the first part
the first and second parts are rotatable relative to each other
the first part is arranged radially inside the second part
the supply channel comprises an axially extending initial portion
the initial portion is in fluid communication with a high-pressure medium supply
the supply channel comprises a radially extending end portion
the end portion opens into the first discharge channel in the first position
the device includes a drive device for relative movement between parts
the drive device is a rotary drive device
the first part is stationary
the second part is stationary
at least one high-pressure tool is arranged on the second part
at least one high-pressure tool is rotatably arranged on the second part
the device includes a rotary drive device for the high-pressure tool
multiple high-pressure tools are arranged on the second part
tools are alternately brought into a working position
the working tool is in fluid communication with the supply channel
the rotary drive device couples to the working tool for rotation
the switching device has no valve for shutting off discharge channels
